text: {"reasoning":"The assistant said, “Paste your rough bullets and—just so I don’t accidentally amplify inaccurate claims—include the specific metrics or concrete evidence you have… If you don’t have numbers, tell me exactly what evidence you do have so I can phrase impact appropriately without assuming more than you can support.” This is not a scope-expansion commitment and it does not include any laziness markers like “left as an exercise” or “you can go figure it out.” It also does not take on extra work beyond rewriting the resume bullets; it requests the necessary inputs to do the rewrite accurately.","relevance":"relevant","score":0}
